unreviewed_scope: Other IDs/sections in these reports and all other inventory paths are not promoted by this batch.

corrections_and_precise_gates.root_rationale: Production runtime_system calls tick_scene_world; world_sync scans node_records, computes capacities and rebuilds four vectors. Arc reuse in query readers does not remove producer full-scene work.
Manager still separates settings, clocks, snapshots, events, command queues and Jolt owners across shared maps; there is no single per-World owner/generation transaction in these spans.

advance_clock retains an accumulator/max_substeps path, while normal tick_scene_world calls fixed_update_step_plan with at most one step using incoming delta. FixedUpdate registration alone does not unify the clocks.

Current settings.rs persists through ConfigManager::set_value at 97-99 before clearing backend/commands or writing settings at 101-109. The historical memory-before-persist failure is source-repaired. Full validation, prepared rebuild and atomic generation publication remain absent in this entry; no execution acceptance is inferred.

synchronize_jolt_world holds a global Jolt map lock through native synchronize; record_jolt_error removes world/snapshot/event entries and stores a global error. Poison recovery tests do not prove the required per-World Faulted owner.

Level replacement epoch guards world mutation and snapshot publication, with an Arc snapshot and unchanged-value reuse. These spans do not carry one world/config/provider/body/tick receipt across separate Scene writeback/event and snapshot calls.

Builtin and plugin managers/modules remain distinct types. Within each module, the AnimationManager facade wraps that module's DefaultAnimationManager; it is not a second solver instance by itself. Source compiler products and plugin evaluator remain separate, with target activation/artifact parity unqualified.

Importer emits authored IBM as a detached Data subasset; plugin palette recomputes posed*bind.inverse and renderer independently does the same at skinning.rs 122-155. Pose-name reorder support is not mesh-joint remap or canonical IBM binding.

Hermite quaternion sampling uses slerp without tangents; glTF morph outputs are explicitly rejected. Typed channel dispatch and interval lookup exist, but do not qualify canonical cubic quaternion/compression/time semantics.

Registered PostUpdate runs a frame function with scene/resource scan, evaluation and multiple sequential publication phases. Existing deferred-entity restoration is reusable, but no unified per-World deadline/cancel/terminal worker receipt is established by these spans.

pose_apply writes scene transforms directly, guarded by replacement epoch; skeletal targets use normalized_weight=1.0. This guards replacement, but does not arbitrate animation/physics/IK/network/cinematic writer ownership or typed root motion.

Pure LookAt/TwoBone jobs and public exports exist; the two cited diagnostic paths are absent and no IK stage appears in the selected normal tick/runtime registration. Deleted files alone do not establish historical runtime regression; current production integration remains unqualified.

Current runtime catalog supplies Net root and, under base-runtime-plugins, HTTP and WebSocket feature registrations. App target and Editor catalog remain incomplete for the required six-feature/target product closure. It is inaccurate to claim all Net provider support is absent.

package.rs declares six optional bundles, but current catalog collector returns only HTTP and WebSocket. RPC/replication/reliable-UDP/content-download registration and dependency closure are still missing; the collector is not root-only anymore.
The Editor provider resolver dispatches Navigation/Neural and returns None for Net; runtime Net target declarations do not register an Editor provider.

HTTP/WebSocket resolve DefaultNetManager and install backends, so those factories are source-repaired. RPC/replication still construct private managers despite declared dependencies; exact shared root ownership across every feature remains open.

Root registers First ingress and Last egress anchors; egress is currently a no-op. RPC/replication files register managers only, not World feature systems. Root event publication is not the missing session/RPC/replication/download execution closure.

NetConfig explicitly documents unconsumed enabled/mode/budgets; package options are metadata and selected scene systems use fixed constants. No immutable validated effective activation snapshot is observed in this bounded chain.
